component.title: ResponsivePanel
component.purpose: Preserve one panel's intent and state while it transforms between a desktop sidebar and a mobile drawer.

states.description: The panel is a persistent, resizable desktop sidebar.
The panel is a focus-contained, scroll-locking mobile drawer.

claims.statement: One controlled open state remains mounted while the responsive presentation changes between desktop and mobile.
The mobile presentation uses dialog semantics, focus containment, focus restoration, safe-area geometry, scroll locking, and top-layer Escape dismissal.
The desktop presentation exposes a keyboard and pointer resize handle and persists the chosen width when storage is available.
